notes: Full description: LintResult (pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:201) and Finding (line 370) do not implement std::fmt::Display. These are the primary output types of the lint engine. Without Display: (1) users cannot write 'println!("{}", finding.result)' to format a lint result for human consumption, (2) the types cannot be used with tracing/log macros that expect Display, (3) error reporting code must format fields manually. Severity also lacks Display, making it impossible to write the variant name without Debug formatting. Fix: implement Display for LintResult (showing 'Pass', 'NotApplicable', 'Warn(detail)', 'Error(detail)', 'Fatal(detail)'), for Severity (showing 'Info', 'Warn', 'Error', 'Fatal'), and a convenience Display for Finding showing 'LINT [lint_id] result at cert[N]'. Note: error::Error is not appropriate here since these are not error types — Display alone is sufficient.
title: RUSTY: LintResult and Finding missing Display impl
